An examination of the Bureau's findings in Appendix B reveals, however, that each progressive step in population category is matched by an incremental increase in the characteristic extent of suburban commercial development. Accordingly, no change is believed to be warranted.
In summation, the economic evidence of record demonstrates the undeniable trend toward urban area expansion since the initial development of the population-mileage formula. While quantification of this development is difficult with respect to a rule of general applicability, the formula adopted in this proceeding defines reasonable bounds reflecting current economic development in urban areas and conform to the statutory requirements of section 203(b)(8).
